- Week 2: SOW draft + pricing appendix delivered (we'll circulate)

- Redwood: Sofia (AM), Karthik (Solutions/Capacity), Neha (Renewals)

2) Horizon — do the proposed timeline weeks look feasible from your side? Any blackout dates we should avoid for the QBR?
3) Redwood — we'll drop a draft SOW and a short capacity appendix attached (Horizon_MAAP_v2.pdf is the uplift profile).

Proposed QBR slots (pick any preferred):
- Tue Dec 7, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Dec 8, 14:00–15:00 PT

Sofia / team — adding an operational note so the uplift can be staged cleanly. Suggested staging (engineering recommendation):
- Day 0–14: Validate prefix/KV cache warmup on a mirrored test pool, bump routed throughput to +10% on non-peak windows.
- Week 3–6: Progressive autoscale threshold lowering to reach +25% while keeping latency SLO intact.
- Month 2: Full traffic cutover to uplifted capacity (+35%) with a rollback window of 48 hours.
